Three m125 measurements form a small loading-solvent and composition design; three m116 measurements trace an aromatic-ether response that changed sharply between 20/1 and 50/1. Matched para/meta aminobenzonitrile points test the corrected nitrogen hypothesis, and m107/m13 points resolve endpoint-specific ketoester curves. Alcohol, sulfoxide, nitro-carbonyl, aromatic-carbonyl, and nitrogen-rich probes extend the lessons to neighboring Row-distribution regions with high predicted widths or documented transfer failures. The selected conditions include both intermediate anchors and boundary-like conditions, so retraining can learn slopes, interactions, and endpoint asymmetry rather than only isolated outliers. The combination should improve generalization across structure-condition-retention relationships, especially where the current model extrapolates from chemically similar but behaviorally different rows."}
